executiveSummary.overallStatus: DEGRADED BY 3 CRITICAL UX DEFECTS & ARCHITECTURAL DISCONNECT
executiveSummary.verdict: The biophysical simulation core, closed-universe thermodynamic conservation (ΔE=0.000, ΔM=0.000), Pattee epistemic cut replication, and Uri Alon motif classification are computationally robust and fully passing 20/20 stages. However, severe UI geometry collisions, persistent telemetry obscuration on standard student laptop viewports, and failure of the live 3D seafloor renderer to execute multi-lens biological morphing fundamentally undermine the designer vision of a serene, uncluttered scientific observatory.

defectA.name: Observatory Silicoid Telemetry & Flyouts Missing/Pushed Off-Screen in Header Bar

livingPopulation.note: Only exists inside compressed preview pill #hud-stats-preview which is pushed off-screen on <= 1440px

sporeCount.note: Completely absent from header bar; buried inside pull-down modal #hud-stats-panel

cladeDiversity.note: Inside #hud-phylogeny-btn which is pushed off-screen at 1280px

generations.note: Inside #hud-phylogeny-btn which is pushed off-screen at 1280px

defectA.rootCauseCode: index.html:33-48 defines header as a single flex row with overflow-x: auto and display: none on webkit scrollbars. Children (.brand-section, #workspace-mode-selector, #hud-lens-selector, .telemetry-row) have fixed non-wrapping flex-shrink: 0 footprints summing to 2,248px. Any display under 2,248px silently clips the rightmost items without visual scrollbars.
defectA.architecturalRedesignSpec: Decouple workspace mode selector and lens selector from top header. Relocate workspace switcher to a sleek vertical left-rail docked HUD pill (48px wide) or integrate lenses directly into viewport context. Keep top header dedicated strictly to brand logo, master run status, and the 5 vital metrics (Population, Spores, Clades, Generations, Epoch Ticks) with permanent flex-shrink prevention and responsive font scaling.

defectB.name: Bottom Transport Bar Collision Covering #floating-env-pill and #floating-btn-visual-key in Non-Fullscreen View
defectB.rootCauseCode: index.html:788-808 positions .transport-bar at bottom: 12px with z-index 25 and flex-wrap: wrap. index.html:4241-4260 positions #floating-env-pill at bottom: 58px with z-index 15. When transport bar wraps onto two lines on standard screens, its height reaches 86px (top edge at 98px from bottom), directly overlaying and burying the env pill. At the same time, max-width: calc(100vw - 32px) stretches the transport bar to 16px from screen edge, directly covering #floating-btn-visual-key (bottom: 14px, left: 14px, z-index: 10).
defectB.architecturalRedesignSpec: Modularize the bloated 22-button transport bar into a compact, single-row 48px glass transport dock containing ONLY simulation playback (Play/Pause, Step, Speed, Shaker). Move camera presets into the 3D viewport camera cluster (#floating-camera-nav-pill). Move environmental filters (Spores, Water, Bedrock, Conduits, Auras, Rays) into a collapsible floating "Layers" drawer. Float #floating-env-pill at top-center (below header) or bottom-right. Elevate #floating-btn-visual-key to bottom: 76px with z-index 35.

defectC.rootCauseCode: The multi-lens biological rendering engine developed in KinematicsOverlay.ts for Chronicle replay was never integrated into SeafloorRenderer3D.ts for live simulation. In SeafloorRenderer3D.ts, drawSilicoidOrganism() hardcodes a rigid 2D circle (ctx.arc) regardless of activeLensMode, so users switching lenses in Observatory, Safari, or Laboratory see no change in organism morphology.
defectC.architecturalRedesignSpec: Refactor SeafloorRenderer3D.ts to consume the lens drawing algorithms from KinematicsOverlay.ts. When in "plasmodium" or "hybrid" lens mode, compute the 2D concave boundary of adjacent occupied pores and render a continuous undulating syncytial envelope with peristaltic waves. When in "vascular" lens mode, render inter-pore hydraulic conduits with animated streaming chevrons representing metabolite shuttle transport.
